title: Building the Bond and Qudwah with Your Child (Ages 4-6)
description: A tarbiyah journey that helps the father build a secure emotional bond with his child in the preoperational stage (Piaget preoperational) through dramatic play, daily dialogue, and short stories, with practical application of the principle of qudwah (role modeling) that begins from the father himself.

primary_reference.info: Abdullah Nasih Ulwan, Tarbiyat al-Awlad fi al-Islam (Raising Children in Islam), Vol. 1 — Chapter 3 (play and rifq)
